name: Akiri
description: Akiri is a kor line-slinger on Zendikar, a veteran of the Battle of Sea Gate and leader of an adventuring party from the Sea Gate Expeditionary House.

summary.text: Akiri is a kor line-slinger on Zendikar, a veteran of the Battle of Sea Gate and leader of an adventuring party from the Sea Gate Expeditionary House.

bio.text: She left her kor band after an Eldrazi attack killed her comrades and came to protect travelers from Ulamog.
She forgave Zareth for leaving Sea Gate, welcomed him home, and planned a Skyclave expedition to Murasa.
On the Magosi Steps, she fought the serpent Verazol and caught the falling Zareth with her line, saving them both.
In the Murasa Skyclave, Zareth was killed by the Core's blast, and when Akiri grabbed the Core and refused to give it up, Nahiri took it and pushed her off a ledge.
Nissa caught her in a bramble, and Akiri agreed to lead Jace to the Singing City.
Years later she searched for Nahiri, haunted by Zareth's death, and led Tazri and her friends into the Skyclave to stop her.
She led her friends out of the collapsing Skyclave as it fell with the corrupted Nahiri trapped inside.

status.text: As of the latest story, Akiri is alive, having led her friends out of the Skyclave as it fell with Nahiri inside.

timeline.summary: Akiri leaves her kor band after an Eldrazi attack kills her comrades.
timeline.quote: she struck out on her own when an Eldrazi attack killed her comrades

timeline.summary: Akiri and Zareth swing up the Umara River Gorge along the Red Route, seeking a fallen hedron on behalf of Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: they had been dispatched by Sea Gate to follow up on rumors of a fallen hedron

timeline.summary: Camped on the gorge rim, Akiri reflects on the Eldrazi, Ulamog and the reminders Zareth's return brings.
timeline.quote: Akiri recalled the chill in Sea Gate under Ulamog

timeline.summary: Zareth gives Akiri a Skyclave hook from the kor of the Trenches in Ondu.
timeline.quote: you take it, I have others.

timeline.summary: Akiri remembers the Battle at Sea Gate and how inexperienced Zareth was when pressed into her unit.
timeline.quote: He had been pressed into the liberation of Sea Gate because he could hold a spear

timeline.summary: Zareth apologizes for leaving Sea Gate and Akiri forgives him, welcoming him home.
timeline.quote: I'm happy to have you back.

timeline.summary: They reach the site of the fallen hedron and find only a strange pool, no artifact.
timeline.quote: It's not a rock, it's an artifact

timeline.summary: Akiri decides to return to Sea Gate to continue their work.
timeline.quote: We go back to Sea Gate,

timeline.summary: At Magosi Portage, Akiri reveals she has hired them onto a caravan to Coralhelm, after Zareth's coin purse prank backfires.
timeline.quote: A caravan bound for Coralhelm, set to depart tomorrow.

timeline.summary: Zareth guesses Akiri plans to volunteer them for a secret Skyclave expedition to Murasa and Akiri confirms.
timeline.quote: Sea Gate thought we might find something useful from a freshly fallen hedron

timeline.summary: Zareth proposes they slip away, but Akiri refuses, insisting on fixing Zendikar and creating power for its people.
timeline.quote: This is our world, all of its agonies and sickness.

timeline.summary: Zareth promises to be there, and Akiri leaves; he spends the night awake.
timeline.quote: The night dragged on long, and Zareth spent none of it asleep.

timeline.summary: Nahiri pitches Akiri's party on retrieving the Lithoform Core from a Murasa Skyclave, claiming it will heal Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The object I seek will heal Zendikar of all its scars.

timeline.summary: Nahiri shows the key, and Zareth proposes a card game of Conquest.
timeline.quote: Adventuring parties like to call this little game Conquest .

timeline.summary: During the game Zareth picks Nahiri's pocket for the key; she turns the cards to granite and demands it back.
timeline.quote: Then she snapped her fingers and turned all the cards to granite.

timeline.summary: Akiri's party agrees to depart at first light.
timeline.quote: When do we head out?

timeline.summary: The party and Nahiri arrive at Sunder Bay on Murasa below the Skyclave.
timeline.quote: When they finally arrived at Sunder Bay on Murasa

timeline.summary: Nahiri freezes a stomper with the key's power and turns it to sand, and the key's power spreads stone-like blight under a tree.
timeline.quote: is just a taste of the Core's power.

timeline.summary: At dawn the caravan prepares to descend the Magosi Steps with Akiri and Zareth as guards.
timeline.quote: The merfolk were Zareth's responsibility

timeline.summary: A Roil tremor shakes the portage; Akiri stays calm and reassures the caravan.
timeline.quote: The Roil—gone briefly after the Eldrazi defeat at Sea Gate—was back.

timeline.summary: The caravan begins descending the steps into thick mist.
timeline.quote: The caravan, Akiri, and Zareth continued down

timeline.summary: An ox breaks its ankle on a loose cobble and is put down.
timeline.quote: Broke an ankle,

timeline.summary: A giant serpent emerges from the mist, attacking the head of the caravan, and Akiri leaps off the switchback to fight it while Zareth draws his knives.
timeline.quote: She coiled, sprinted, and then leapt off the switchback

timeline.summary: Akiri climbs Verazol's back toward its eyes, but its second head knocks her from the beast and she falls.
timeline.quote: The second mouth flings her to the side, into the open air.

timeline.summary: Akiri survives the fall onto a lower switchback, but Verazol's main head looms over her.
timeline.quote: It bites, and Akiri holds through the swing that follows

timeline.summary: Akiri catches the falling Zareth with her line, saving them both as Verazol devours the caravan above.
timeline.quote: She falls, catching Zareth's outstretched hand

timeline.summary: Zareth says he had no choice and Akiri comforts him; the two survivors reach the base and avoid Coralhelm on the road to Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: They waited a day, but no one else followed.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and her party climb stairs she stonecrafts toward the Murasa Skyclave, Nahiri eager to erase the Roil with the Core.
timeline.quote: With the Lithoform Core, she would erase the Roil and make Zendikar as beautiful and tranquil as it was millennia ago.

timeline.summary: Nahiri uses the key to light a stone path through the Skyclave, and the party follows it past traps.
timeline.quote: Then the glowing stones stretched out in a single line deep into the ruins.

timeline.summary: In the cavern, a monolith opens to reveal the Lithoform Core, and Nahiri stops Akiri from touching it.
timeline.quote: "Careful." Nahiri's hand clamped over her wrist in an instant.

timeline.summary: Nahiri takes the Core and the chamber and Skyclave begin to collapse as the Roil strikes.
timeline.quote: the surrounding chamber was disintegrating, falling, tearing itself apart

timeline.summary: Nahiri whispers to Zareth that she knows he wants the Core and uses stone to help them swing across.
timeline.quote: I know you want the Core for yourself.

timeline.summary: Nahiri fails to bend a vortex and is thrown off the ruin, but Akiri catches her.
timeline.quote: "Got you!" Akiri gasped and grinned.

timeline.summary: A lava elemental born of the Roil attacks, and Akiri shields Zareth.
timeline.quote: Akiri was there in front of Zareth

timeline.summary: Zareth lies dead, killed by the Core's blast, and Akiri grieves him.
timeline.quote: Akiri was on her knees, holding the cold, stiff body of the person she loved.

timeline.summary: Akiri grabs the Core and refuses to give it to Nahiri, but a hedron's dark energy freezes her.
timeline.quote: The hedron sparked and dark energy reached out from it, coursing through her

timeline.summary: Nahiri takes the Core and pushes the paralyzed Akiri off the ledge.
timeline.quote: Akiri could do nothing as Nahiri planted a hand on her shoulder. And pushed.

timeline.summary: Akiri falls from the Skyclave, remembering Zareth's death, and accepts she will die.
timeline.quote: She would see Zareth soon.

timeline.summary: Nissa catches Akiri in a bramble and hauls her onto a ladder of branches.
timeline.quote: there was a bramble branch curled tightly around her chest

timeline.summary: Akiri realizes Nissa and Jace are planeswalkers, and learns Nahiri has the Core.
timeline.quote: I've met Nahiri. She's the one who pushed me.

timeline.summary: Jace tries a mind attack on Nahiri, who retaliates with a boulder; Akiri saves Jace by swinging them back onto the ladder.
timeline.quote: Look out!" Akiri shouted, pushing Jace out of the way

timeline.summary: Nissa senses that Nahiri went north, and Jace reveals he read her mind: she is going to the Singing City.
timeline.quote: She's going to the Singing City.

timeline.summary: Nissa goes ahead alone on jurworrell roots, vowing to stop Nahiri and destroy the Core.
timeline.quote: I will stop Nahiri and destroy the Core,

timeline.summary: Jace promises to take the Core beyond Zendikar and Akiri agrees to lead him to the Singing City.
timeline.quote: I'll take you to the entrance of the City so you can help Nissa

timeline.summary: Akiri's party searches for Nahiri following Tazri's vision, and Akiri spots the changed Nahiri on an isolated fragment.
timeline.quote: She has changed, but even from a distance, Akiri knows who it is.

timeline.summary: Akiri tracks Nahiri, watching the Skyclave turn to white metal and more invaders arrive.
timeline.quote: She's witnessed the Skyclave's broken stone mend and transform into white metal.

timeline.summary: Linvala brings Tazri to Akiri's party, and they agree they are the only ones left to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We are the only ones left to stop Nahiri,"

timeline.summary: The party enters the Skyclave through a small uncorrupted entrance, resolved to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We did not defeat the Eldrazi to be destroyed by this,"

timeline.summary: The party kills a corrupted tree elemental, and Orah's fingers are covered in black oil.
timeline.quote: The tips of his fingers are covered in a sickly black oil.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Phyrexianized elementals, the party is saved when Linvala's light parts the elementals and reveals a door.
timeline.quote: Tazri looks and sees Linvala radiating with light and charging forward.

timeline.summary: They barricade the door and find the carcasses of the Skyclave's creatures.
timeline.quote: Around them are the carcasses of every living creature that didn't survive the Phyrexian transformation.

timeline.summary: The party confronts Nahiri, who recognizes Akiri and smashes her thrown knife with stone.
timeline.quote: "Tiny elementals. Cute," Nahiri says

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone attacks beat back Tazri and her friends, and it seems Zendikar is lost.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is lost.

timeline.summary: Linvala's radiance and Tazri's halo burn away oil and stun Phyrexia's power; Tazri hurls the halo at Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Tazri yanks the halo off from around her neck and in one desperate movement, hurls it at the entombed Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Akiri leads her friends out of the collapsing Skyclave, leaping into the sky and catching a hedron with her rope.
timeline.quote: But Akiri is a master line-slinger and midway through their failing arc, she lets her rope fly.

timeline.summary: The Skyclave falls with the corrupted Planeswalker trapped inside, while the sky takes on a soft iridescent glow.
timeline.quote: The Emeria Skyclave is falling to the earth.

relations.note: She safeguards travelers from the titan.
relations.quote: Now she uses her line-slinging expertise to safeguard travelers from Ulamog.

relations.note: Old friends and companions on the mission.
relations.quote: Zareth, her old friend and companion

relations.note: She led him in the Battle and critiques his slinging.
relations.quote: the young kor officer who pulled him through the darkness at Sea Gate

relations.note: She is a line-slinger and expedition leader of the House.
relations.quote: the rangers, line-slingers, and adventurers of the Expeditionary House

relations.note: She fought them during the Battle.
relations.quote: The Eldrazi killed with a touch—some with their mere presence.

relations.note: They show affection and hold hands.
relations.quote: He grinned up at her with affection, placing his hand on top of hers.

relations.note: Akiri leads the adventuring party of four.
relations.quote: She, Nahiri could tell, was their leader.

relations.note: Close friends who support each other through the Battle and the attack.
relations.quote: Akiri remained silent and held her friend as he sobbed

relations.note: Nahiri pushes her off a ledge to take the Core.
relations.quote: Akiri could do nothing as Nahiri planted a hand on her shoulder. And pushed.

relations.note: Akiri holds the body of the person she loved.
relations.quote: holding the body of her friend, her love, close

relations.note: Nahiri pushed Akiri to her death.
relations.quote: She's the one who pushed me.

relations.note: Akiri thinks of her friend and love.
relations.quote: She closed her eyes and thought of her friend and love

relations.note: Akiri trusts Tazri's vision and fights with her
Nahiri has haunted Akiri's dreams since Zareth's death
relations.quote: That figure, that face, has haunted her dreams since she lost Zareth.

relations.note: Orah is one of Akiri's companions
relations.quote: Her companions—her friends—insisted on coming with her

relations.note: Kaza calls Akiri boss and follows her

pages_say.description: A kor line-slinger on Zendikar who left her band after an Eldrazi attack and now protects travelers from Ulamog.
A battle-worn kor line-slinger, veteran of the Battle of Sea Gate and member of the Expeditionary House, who plans a mission to Murasa.
A renowned kor line-slinger and leader of an adventuring party from the Sea Gate Expeditionary House.
A kor line-slinger and veteran who guards a merfolk caravan down the Magosi Steps and fights the serpent Verazol.
A kor line-slinger and leader of the adventuring party, who loses Zareth to the Core and is betrayed by Nahiri.
A kor line-slinger, saved from her fall by Nissa, who guides Jace toward the Singing City while grieving Zareth.
A kor line-slinger who searches for Nahiri, haunted by the loss of Zareth, and leads the party into the Skyclave.
